title: Run final functional audit and decide next production-distro gate
purpose: Close the functional iteration with a clean audit and decide whether AgentOS is ready for the next production-distro implementation gate.
scope: Run workspace tests, safety tests, functional replay, release gate, and optional QEMU runtime smoke.
Verify all TASK-FUNC evidence files exist and parse.
Verify capability matrix, contract ownership, release replay, and update readiness are aligned.
Record final decision: functional-ready, functional-remediation-required, or rollout-blocked.
deliverables: TASK.md update with completed functional iteration status
implementation_steps: Run required test and replay commands from a clean worktree or clean main.
Scan for private key paths and PEM private key blocks.
Write final audit decision and next production-distro blockers.
acceptance_criteria: All required gates pass or blockers are explicit.
No concrete private key paths or PEM private key blocks are committed.
Final audit includes command outputs, hashes, and decision.
Next production-distro gate has clear entry criteria.
failure_modes: Final audit runs from dirty worktree without recording it.
Evidence files are missing or malformed.
Functional replay is skipped but decision says ready.
Private signing material path leaks into evidence.

blocked_until: Final audit produces functional-ready or explicit remediation plan.
